[[Arch-Provost/Legends|Arch-Provost]] '''Bengila Urlan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who led the [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-manufacturer [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In an attempt to counter the success that had been brought to Rendili's rival [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] by their [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] and [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] lines, Urlan tasked various [[Information broker/Legends|infochants]] and StarDrive [[Spy/Legends|spies]] with stealing and copying Kuati starship designs. Urlan later persuaded the KDY designer [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] to come and work for StarDrive, which Urlan believed would cripple his rivals.
